MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) where this Portable Avatar is placed.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) associated with this Portable Avatar.

PortableAvatarID.description: Unique identifier of this Portable Avatar instance.

PortableAvatarTime.description: Time this Portable Avatar was produced.

PortableAvatarSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Portable Avatar applies.

AVSceneSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when the Audio-Visual Scene is located in the M-Instance.

AVSceneDescriptors.description: Descriptors of the Audio-Visual Scene where the Avatar is embedded.

AvatarSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when the Avatar is located in the Audio-Visual Scene.

AvatarSpatialAttitude.description: Spatial Attitude (position and orientation) of the Avatar with respect to the Audio-Visual Scene described by AVSceneDescriptors.

AvatarOrAvatarID.description: The Avatar's ID (a string) and its Model: a 3D Model Object or a Basic 3D Model Object (for instance, one that names a file the receiver holds).

TextObject.description: Text Object associated with the Avatar, or to be converted into a Speech Object.

MLModelOrMLModelID.description: Either an ML Model for Speech Synthesis or its ID.

SPOOrSPOID.description: Either a Speech Object (or a Basic Speech Object) that the Avatar utters or its ID.

FaceDescriptorsObject.description: Face Descriptors Object of the Avatar: descriptive (of a human) or generative (of a machine).

BodyDescriptorsObject.description: Body Descriptors Object of the Avatar: descriptive (of a human) or generative (of a machine).

Accessories.description: Set of Accessories attached to the Avatar.

Accessory.description: An Accessory attached to the Avatar.

AccessorySpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Accessory is located on the Avatar.

ProcessID.description: Identifier of the process that made or last changed this Portable Avatar (what the retired Avatar, PAF-AVT, carried as ProcessID).

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this Portable Avatar in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Portable Avatar (plain text, max 2048 characters).
